Why long replies read dense on the phone

The stack draws every item at the same weight, so a long answer and a one-line tool row compete for attention. Three things make it worse:

- Body text is 15pt with tight line spacing: fine for a sentence, tiring for a page.
- Tool rows sit flush against prose, with no gap that says the agent stopped talking here.
- Inline code like Palette.raised renders at body size, so it reads louder than the words around it.

 What I changed

1. Raised paragraph spacing in MarkdownView from 6 to 10 points.
2. Gave a tool row a 12pt top margin when it follows an assistant message.
3. Dropped inline code to 0.92em and tinted its background.

The numbers live in one place now:

swift
enum Spacing {
    static let paragraph: CGFloat = 10
    static let toolAfterProse: CGFloat = 12
    static let inlineCodeScale: CGFloat = 0.92
}


 Before and after

 Surface  Before  After 
 ---  ---  --- 
 Paragraph gap  6pt  10pt 
 Tool row after prose  0pt  12pt 
 Inline code  1.0em  0.92em 

Measured at the default Dynamic Type size; larger sizes scale with it.

 Where to look

- The reasoning is in the [architecture notes](docs/architecture.md), under Publishing.
- Apple's guidance: [Human Interface Guidelines: Typography](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/typography).
- The renderer is mobile/conch-ios/conch-ios/MarkdownView.swift, and the stack that spaces items is ConversationStack.swift.

Source guards pass. Want the same spacing on the Mac pane?
